svg.title: The toy topology and its learning site
svg.desc: The committed toy graph: 40 nodes on a circle with its 150 directed weighted edges drawn between them. The plastic site is the association edges; the per-family readout over the active set never learns. The shuffled and random control arms rewire these edges while preserving the counts.
svg.text: An authored toy graph, and where learning lives
drawn from data/course/graph-toy.json; the originating experiments froze a measured connectome this repository does not ship
no-hop: step-zero set only, no edge keys
edge opacity follows raw weight; a toy mechanism figure, not evidence about any topology
